title: I need a lawyer but can't afford one
triggers: who can get free legal help

rights.plain_explanation: The State must provide free legal aid, so no one is denied justice because they're poor or disadvantaged.

Free legal services are available to women and children, SC/ST members, people in custody, victims of trafficking or disaster, persons with disabilities, industrial workers, and people below the income limit.

do_now: Or visit the District Legal Services Authority at your district court.
Carry any papers about your case.

escalation.label: Free legal aid
escalation.detail: Call NALSA on 15100 or visit your District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) at the district court. Women, children, people in custody and people below the income limit get a free lawyer.

notes: The income limit is set by each state.
